inv.desc_en:
I OFFER YOU THIS PROPOSAL.

YOU DECIDE.

DETAILS: With a 6m frontage, at street level with direct access.
2 bathrooms (one for people with reduced mobility).
Automatic entrance door.
Remote-controlled shutter.
Air conditioning.
Community fees: €135 (includes water).
IBI (Property Tax): €581.17.

LOCATION: The most commercial area of Cuatro Caminos. 1 minute from Cuatro Caminos Metro station. Several bus lines. Citizen Service Office. Police station. Department of Transport. Excellent for any type of business, your investment is secure.

You can visit without obligation; we would be delighted to assist and advise you.
